description: Institutional Data Governance — every data domain has a formal SLA. FATAL violations trigger circuit-breaker lock (no new positions). WARN violations block retraining but allow live trading. Each probe runs in an isolated sandbox — one failure cannot crash the audit.

alpha_registry.description: Alpha Portfolio Allocator — must track real trade performance
alpha_registry.blast_radius: Alpha Allocation: $100K capital idle — no brain receives funding without performance data

record_count_min.message: Zero alpha records — allocator has nothing to allocate

trade_count_nonzero.message: Alpha records exist but all have trade_count=0 — feed pipeline not wired

win_rate_valid.message: All alpha records have win_rate=0 — performance tracking broken

leaderboard.description: Brain Leaderboard — must be consistent with config and governance
leaderboard.blast_radius: Brain Selection: frozen/retired brains may receive capital, live brains may be muted

no_zombie_brains.check: no brain with status='live' in leaderboard has enabled=false in config
no_zombie_brains.expected: leaderboard status matches config enabled flag
no_zombie_brains.message: Leaderboard shows live brains that are disabled in config — zombie brains consuming signals

no_frozen_as_live.message: Brain status mismatch between governance and leaderboard

live_labels.description: Live Trade Labels — training data quality gate
live_labels.blast_radius: Training Data: unlabeled trades contaminate supervised learning datasets

unlabeled_rate_max.message: Unlabeled rate exceeds 15% — training labels contaminated

label_in_whitelist.message: Unknown label values detected — label taxonomy broken

retraining_signal.description: Brain Retraining Assessment — must periodically evaluate brain degradation
retraining_signal.blast_radius: Brain Quality: degraded brains continue trading without retraining trigger

brains_assessed_nonzero.message: Zero brains assessed — retraining pipeline may be idle or dead

meta_exit.description: Meta Exit Telemetry — exit reason classification quality
meta_exit.blast_radius: Exit Quality: 42% unknown_close means training labels rely on PnL sign, not exit mechanism

unknown_close_rate_max.message: More than 35% of exits have unknown reason — exit classifier broken

trail_data_present.message: Zero trail exits recorded — trail telemetry blind spot

brain_performance.description: Per-brain performance metrics — must record SignalSettled for active brains
brain_performance.blast_radius: Brain Evaluation: probation brains have no independent performance data

active_brains_have_signals.check: each active brain has >= 1 SignalSettled with position_ticket > 0
active_brains_have_signals.message: Active brains have zero real SignalSettled events — performance measurement blind

metadata.author: quant-os
metadata.rationale: Institutional Data Governance: configuration-driven, severity-graded, fault-tolerant. One contract, one validator, all data domains. FATAL locks trading, WARN blocks training, each probe runs in isolated sandbox.
metadata.supersedes: ad-hoc data_health checks in data_health_service.py (partial, hardcoded, non-configurable)
